assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / compositing.
Create ONE replacement navigation banner for a Russian clay botanical app.
Input image 1 is the old banner: use it for the core narrative and botanical material, NOT its layout.
Input image 2 is the APPROVED REVISED STYLE GUIDE (Темперамент): follow its restrained palette, burgundy negative space, foreground sculpted type and balanced forms.

Art direction: a complete INDEPENDENT ILLUSTRATION that would look intentional and balanced if all lettering were removed. Spread the meaningful shapes across left, center and right. Do not reserve an empty left text column or push the scene into one corner. The title is a separate fully opaque FOREGROUND OVERLAY, visibly overlapping some central illustration forms. No branch, leaf or object in front of any letter. Large shapes with restrained pressed detail, warm gentle lighting, refined handmade plasticine.

Keep approximately 50–60% of the canvas as clearly visible deep burgundy, continuous generous negative space between forms. Muted ochre, warm terracotta, ivory and brown dominate; desaturated gray-sage green is a SMALL accent. The user rejected dense green leaf wallpaper, so no foliage carpet, edge-filling leaves, forest or decorative frame. Use only the few objects specified in the scene. No brown horizontal strip, ground slab across the canvas, oversized clay platform, ribbon, plaque or title panel.

Typography: match the cream rounded heavy SLAB-SERIF modelling-clay type of approved input image 2; gentle volume, conventional upright Cyrillic, correct spelling, warm ivory face and a subtle burgundy drop shadow. Use the SAME font size as reference 2, even for short words; at normalized 960x400 capitals approximately 68px and lowercase x-height 48px. Never enlarge a short title. Long words can occupy up to 86% of the width, no clipping or horizontal squeezing. Center the heading block horizontally and vertically over the independent artwork, keeping every letter readable. For two-line headings, same font size on both lines with compact but clear line spacing.

Wide landscape 2.4:1, edge to edge, one banner alone. No UI controls, extra text, numerals, logos, watermark, border or small decorative props.
Scene and meaning: Preserve the idea of repetition and a possible new direction: a SINGLE ochre clay trail makes a clearly readable broad LOOP through the left, center and right of the canvas around one small sculpted oak near center-right. A small fork exits the loop toward ONE fresh sprout near the left/upper-left. The loop is a distinct thin warm clay path set directly on burgundy, NOT a broad brown island or a horizontal soil strip. Just three large subdued autumn oak leaves on the tree, only one small gray-sage green accent. The looping path, small tree and sprout create a complete balanced composition spanning the width, independently of the lettering. The title overlaps part of the loop and tree trunk from the front.
Only exact title, with precisely these line breaks:
"Повторяющиеся
события"
Use exactly TWO centered lines.
